notes.title: It’s Been 3 Months – Here’s What’s Next for Spellpowder Uprising:
notes.notes: [h3]Greetings, tacticians![/h3][p]It's been 3 months already since the game released! To celebrate this little milestone, there's a week-long sale now. So if it’s been on your wishlist (or a friend’s), now’s a great time to jump into the world of Spellpowder.[/p][p]As for those who already played (or even finished) the game - I really hope it met your expectations and had fun with it. Also, if you haven’t written a Steam review yet, it would help a lot if you did.[/p][p][/p][h3]Future plans:[/h3][p]Before moving on onto the other games, I'd like to try adding some things to Uprising, specifically:[/p][list][*][p]Controller Support - Handheld devices are getting more and more popular. Even though the game was primarily made to be touch screen compatible (the plan was scrapped when hub area was introduced) I'll try to map controls to gamepad to at least a playable level (that means can beat the whole game without resorting to keyboard and mouse). I imagine the update could come out somewhere this year.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization - I'm still somewhat on the fence about this one, since the codebase was not written with localization in mind, but I'd like to see if that would move non-English speaking markets. It would be translator/AI translated texts, so I think there's little need to wait for that, if you can understand English (maybe for second playthrough?). Not set on languages too I'd expect for this update to come out somewhere in winter or even later.[/p][/*][/list][p]That is all for now, if you have any questions, feel free to ask here, in community hub or on Discord server![/p][p][/p][p]Keep your gears oiled and your crystals clear,[/p][p]Rogandir[/p]

notes.title: Update notes for July 13th
notes.notes:
Greetings, tacticians! Hope you're doing well. Have a small patch for you:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with camera on Chapter VIII while using "Free Camera". Thanks to [b]Willsama[/b] for reporting
[*] Fixed issue with changing resolutions in Windowed mode

Also updated Mac and Linux builds to the latest version too.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for June 5th
notes.notes:
Greetings, tacticians! Another small update to make your playthroughs smoother:
[olist]
[*] Pressing 'Space' when character is selected will set it to 'Defend'
[*] Added some gleam to dropped loot
[*] Added save game deletion confirmation to prevent accidental save deletes
[*] Fixed soft-locking when going through a character standing on loot. Hopefully haven't introduced any new issues with that.
[/olist]
Also, a reminder to leave a steam review. Still need some to reach 10 of those!
Cheers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41290839/b58c71256a17bc6b8154761ec8170d1429093c68.png[/img]

notes.title: Update notes for May 26th
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers! I hope your travels are going well. Here's a small update with some graphical adjustments and quality-of-life improvements:

[list]
[*] As requested on the discussion boards, I've added an option for free camera movement! The camera no longer follows the active/selected character and can now be moved freely, even during enemy turns. You'll find this setting in the options menu.
[*] Adjusted contrast slightly - colors should now appear more vivid.
[*] Fixed an issue where the objective window wouldn't disappear on very wide screens.
[*] Fixed visual issues in the airship.
[*] Fixed a few typos.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41290839/894568ef2cee0d520533646c936397781ae9a1e7.png[/img]

Have a great adventure, and please leave a review if you have a moment!
Cheers!

notes.title: Spellpowder: Uprising is released!
notes.notes:
After a long wait (5+ years!) Spellpowder: Uprising is finally released. Much work and love went into this and I hope you'll enjoy the game at least as much as I enjoyed making it.
If you encounter any issues or have some feedback, feel free to use steam discussion board or even join a discord server, where I can answer that.
And of course leaving a steam review is always helpful!

Best of luck in your adventures in Spellpowder: Uprising!

notes.title: Only Month Left
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Tacticians![/b]

Only one month left until the release of [b]Spellpowder: Uprising[/b]! The game is nearly complete, with all content in and marked for review. What remains are some final balancing adjustments and bug fixes (I’ve already squashed a few, but there are always more to find!).

To help test the game publicly, I’ll be streaming every Sunday at 6PM GMT on Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/rogandir. Come join me for these final steps of the journey—test out the game’s balancing, help spot bugs, or just chat about the game’s state and lore.

Until the next adventure,
Rogandir Studio

notes.title: Spellpowder: Uprising starts Steam Next Fest with a release date!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41290839/0ecb9ec3f3cd913c47bca2014aedab68079aff79.png[/img]

The uprising has begun! Spellpowder: Uprising is now live in Steam Next Fest, with an updated demo, that features first four chapters of the game, along with cutscenes and intro cinematic. Download the demo now and take command in a world where gunpowder and steel challenge Magia!

I'm also excited to announce that Spellpowder: Uprising launches on [b]May 22[/b]! The battle for the future is fast approaching—add the game to your wishlist and be ready when the war begins.

Play the demo, join the uprising, and shape the fate of a world at the crossroads of magic and technology.

If you you enjoyed the game or want to share your experience, feel free to join [url=https://discord.com/invite/eP8bwvHJdn]game discord server[/url].

notes.title: Spellpowder: Uprising is participating in the Next Fest
notes.notes:
Greetings tacticians,

Spellpowder: Uprising will be participating in an upcoming Steam Next Fest, from February 24 with a new updated demo. This one will feature cutscenes and other updates from internal build. It will be a last demo update (without some bug fixing if needed) before game release.
To prepare for that, old demo will be taken down.

The new demo will come online on Next Fest, so feel free to try new demo and share your experiences in Spellpowder discord server.

Stay strong,

notes.title: The wait is almost over!
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Work on a Spellpowder: Uprising is coming to an end, so it's high time to set a release date. And that is year 2025. I know, I know it's somewhat vague, but since the game was started in 2020 even knowing years is great.

So what can you expect is this time?
[list]
[*] Streaming - not sure Youtube or Twitch, but will be streaming more often, to show the game
[*] Kickstarter? - might create a campaign to see how it works and goes, not 100% sure yet
[*] Voice Acting audition - more info will be on Discord server some time later
[*] Next Fest in 2025 with updated demo and new trailer
[/list]
And game release of course, biggest event of them all. So stay tuned (mostly on Discord) and see you all later.

notes.title: Spellpowder: Uprising will participate in Steam Strategy Fest with a NEW DEMO
notes.notes:
Greetings Tacticians!

Steam Strategy Fest is in few days and what is a better way to celebrate it than with a new demo, eh? So starting from August 28th new demo will be available in Spellpowder steam page in which you will be able to create your own character and test how it would fare against challenges in first four chapters.

If you will be streaming or recording your playthrough, please share your experience in [url=https://discord.com/invite/eP8bwvHJdn]Spellpowder's Discord channel[/url]

Hope to see you there!
